description: We are building "Earth Information Jukebox," a project that merges global data with creative tech to turn the planet's information into an immersive audiovisual experience. Our team brings a strong foundation in hardware aesthetics, conceptual design, and AI sound generation. We are looking for passionate full-stack developers and data visualization wizards to help bring our interactive elements to life. Join us if you want to geek out, build something unique, and give the Earth a voice!
